all.releaseNotes:
We’re continuously enhancing the ADIB Mobile App to make your banking experience simpler, more accessible, and more convenient. Thank you for your feedback, which helps us deliver meaningful improvements with every release.

 •   Enjoy the new experience in ADIB Mobile using Hindi and Urdu languages, making banking more accessible in your preferred language.
 •   Explore the newly Universal Account, with an enhanced onboarding experience and updated eligibility.
 •   General enhancements, performance improvements, and bug fixes. 

We continue to improve the ADIB Mobile App, thanks to your feedback.
